scope.casewise_gate: Existing 95% completion, <=5% each fall/stall/escape and zero history base-contact environments; 31/32 passes, 30/32 fails
scope.selection_method: first require existing gates at both speeds; retain each failure/geometry/seed and measurement exposure, then compare pauses, current/history contact, tracking, action variation and root jerk. No weighted scalar or newest-update rule.
scope.statistic_averaging: arithmetic mean of seed-level aggregates per case; macro group means equally weight cases, not pooled trajectory RMS
scope.numerical_comparison: strict numerical lower counts do not establish a calibrated meaningful improvement
scope.final_validation_limitation: This reused 24-case tuning/regression matrix is not independent final candidate validation. The equal-update matched faithful control is complete and reported separately.

contact_sampling.force_measure: world-frame vector norm of net normal force, including riser normals; no tangential friction force
contact_sampling.slip_velocity_measure: foot-link world-horizontal speed at the policy boundary; not contact-point tangential slip
contact_sampling.legacy_results: reports without this metadata keep their original sampling semantics and cannot be assumed to use physics-step history

contact_candidate_selection.reason: contact620 is the only contact checkpoint passing every case/seed at both 0.3 and 0.5 m/s under the unchanged 95% traversal gate. contact640 and contact670 have concentrated 20 cm descent failures at 0.3 m/s; lower action/jerk or better tracking does not offset those failures.
contact_candidate_selection.remaining_limits: contact620 has two 17 cm rise/25 cm tread ascent stalls and a 3.62 s pause at 0.3 m/s, plus residual contact and impact concerns. This chooses a contact-branch candidate for independent final evaluation; smoothness and real robot readiness remain unverified.
contact_candidate_selection.faithful_control_status: Matched faithful670 passes both speeds; faithful620 fails the low-speed gate. Compare contact620 and faithful670 on independent final cases; the tuning matrix does not select a universal smoothness winner.

limits: Per-env initial orientation/full state is not stored; aggregate distributions do not prove exact per-env heading matching.
Nominal startup foot/material/dynamics are fixed across reset seeds; three reset seeds are not three new material draws.
Current/history any-leg fractions differ from body-count reward, friction force, duration or damage; slip is foot-link speed proxy.
Sparse 0.1 s body traces cover one env/case/seed and do not give full-batch impact peaks.
Motion improvement flag only reports a pause threshold; all source smoothness certification remains unverified.
Early failures and different finish times truncate aggregate trajectories; never rank competence from low motion statistics alone.

material_provenance.foot_material: Initial/final actual foot readbacks are fixed at static friction 0.8, dynamic friction 0.6, restitution 0. The nominal material event covers all robot bodies in domain none; foot readbacks do not establish an isolated foot material test.

terrain_material_by_evaluation.scope: New readbacks record actual composed terrain USD authored material bindings and attributes, not solver-effective contact-pair coefficients. Missing old readbacks cannot be reconstructed.

independent_speed05_motion_review.scope: IndependentCPU review of sparse0.1s traces,one environment percase/seed; not wholebatch peak or contact duration. The per-model largest peaks occur in different cases and are not a matched-case impact comparison.

excluded_case_seed.interpretation: lowercontact/action onfailedortruncatedepisodes does not establish smoothercompetenttraversal

independent_speed03_620_670_motion_revie.sampling_limitation: oneenv/case/seed at0.1s; sampledpeaks fromdifferentcases cannot be ranked ascontrolledimpact peaks

subsequent_matched_faithful_control.interpretation: Contact reduces current leg contact consistently in this training realization, with update/speed-specific action, jerk, slip, tracking and force tradeoffs. One training seed and this reused tuning matrix do not establish broad causality or independent final success.

same_batch_contact620_speed03_recheck.scope: Same declared seeds, geometry and matching saved initial xyz; full initial quaternion/RNG/GPU trajectory equality is unverified. Exact outcome signatures do not imply equal continuous metrics.
